text: Final categorization: EXCLUDED (Justification: This is an ecological research paper focused on species distribution modeling of an invasive plant species (Rhododendron ponticum) under land cover and climate change scenarios in a specific national park (Snowdonia National Park, Wales). The study does include land cover simulation for 2050 using MLP-Markov Chain model and six GCMs for climate scenarios, but the primary focus is on predicting the future distribution of the invasive species, not on land use/land cover (LULC) prediction itself. The scale is local (national park) rather than national, and the land cover simulation is a supporting step rather than the main research objective. Also, the study does not present multiple quantitative accuracy metrics for the land cover simulation itself, nor a national-scale spatial implementation. Therefore, it fails the core inclusion criteria requiring national-scale spatial implementation and primary focus on LULC prediction. It is also not a review article.)
